body:
### Foreground verification on this head (`f29b0be7`)

**Smoke, by parts, against the published mirror, both viewports, each redirected to a file**
(`node tools/smoke_budget.mjs --for-diff` prices this diff at parts 1-15 because a master and
the manifests moved; this is the **measured subset** that covers what actually changed — the
record's own account on its card, and the liberties compiled into the scene — and is **not**
a claim of the conservative all-15 request):

| leg | result | time | ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=mobile SMOKE_STAGE=3-4` | **SMOKE PASS** — 139 passed, 0 failed, **zero page errors** (126 staged + 13 always-on) | 4 m 12 s | 10 m |
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=desktop SMOKE_STAGE=3` | **SMOKE PASS** — 107 passed, 0 failed, **zero page errors** (94 staged + 13 always-on) | 4 m 09 s | 10 m |

Named checks that bear directly on this change, both green at 390×780: *the Sauganash is
rendered as its two-mass plan*, *no building hovers above the ground beneath it*, *rendered
height matches the documented wall height*, *every structure is rendered at a believable
size*. At 1280×800 the record/mesh/placement identity checks (T-1727) and the card are green.

**Source gate**, `./tools/check.sh --part k/4`, one foreground call each:

| part | result |
|---|---|
| 1/4 | red on `Source-use backlinks match authored claims (T-1248)` → fixed with `compile_source_use.py` (`SOURCE USE PASS — 559 sources; all source IDs resolve`) |
| 2/4 | red on two steps, **both artefacts of this worker** (below) |
| 3/4 | red on `the register's four documented men still head the roofs the deal gives them` → fixed by declaring `phases[].form.main_gable_cornice.note` in `name_pool_keys.json` (`replace_invented_residents.py --check` OK). **Re-run green but for the worker artefact below.** |
| 4/4 | **CHECK PASS** — 290 steps, none red |

The three residual reds, stated rather than read as passes:

* `Every selected natural-standing derivative reproduces from its exact canonical parent
  (T-1790)` (parts 2 and 3) — `human_natural_idle.py` runs `git show
  623eccd8…:chicago/4d/assets/humans/bardwell_otis_1835.lod0.glb`, and this checkout is a
  **`--depth 1` clone**: the repository is 14.4 GB and a full clone did not finish inside the
  run, so that commit is not present. `fatal: path … exists on disk, but not in '623eccd8…'`.
* `Selected upper-lid source preserves 925/eyeUV/hoof ownership … (T-3088)` (part 2) —
  `tools/transport/horse_socket_interface_v1/socket_controls.py` calls `np.cross` on 2-D
  vectors, which **NumPy 2.x removed**; this runner has 2.x. `ValueError: Both input arrays
  must be (arrays of) 3-dimensional vectors`.

Neither file is in this diff and neither step reaches this change's domain. **The authority on
this head is the hosted whole-source `gate` check on this PR** — the same complete gate in
eight parts, on a full clone, with CI's own pins — and this PR is not merged until it is green.

*Not filed:* `tools/dev-smoke-state.mjs record` for the two legs above, deliberately — filing
it would add a commit and re-run the hosted gate for bookkeeping. The two readings are in the
table.

### Re-verified on the merged head `16f28e39`

`dev` moved under this branch (T-3041, #1685) and the PR went **dirty**. Resolved by merging
`origin/dev` in — five conflicts, all in append-only or generated files, every one resolved by
keeping both sides and **rebuilding** the generated ones rather than hand-picking rows
(`compile_liberties.py` → 993 liberties, `compile_source_use.py` → `SOURCE USE PASS`,
`web_derivatives.sh --only` re-recording this branch's 23 frame_tavern masters over dev's row
set, `compile_scene.py --all`). Green Tree **#1684 is still open and unmerged**, so no combined
Green Tree bake is owed; the fort house dev brought is a different archetype.

Re-run in the foreground on the merged tree, after `tools/publish.sh`:

| check | result |
|---|---|
| `validate.py --stale` | **clean** — no stale master, no stale version mesh |
| `tools/test_frame_tavern_picture_features.py` | **25 tests, OK** |
| `node tools/changelog-entries.mjs --check` | OK |
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=mobile SMOKE_STAGE=3-4 … --published` | **SMOKE PASS** — 139 passed, 0 failed, zero page errors, 4 m 08 s |
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=desktop SMOKE_STAGE=3 … --published` | **SMOKE PASS** — 107 passed, 0 failed, zero page errors, 4 m 05 s |

Both viewports green on the head that is proposed for merge. The hosted whole-source `gate`
check on this head is the authority on the four-part source gate — including the two steps this
`--depth 1` / NumPy 2.x worker cannot take, which are named in the comment above — and this PR
must not merge until it is green.
